name: kmesh-5
rationale: Bound the still-untested k-point sensitivity after the CO2 CPU/GPU and paired atom-grid differences were small. Change only the crystal Gamma-centered mesh from 3x3x3 to 5x5x5; retain full K290 symmetry reduction and the original tolerance, frozen coordinates/basis/cutoffs/atom grids/D3/SCF, original Spark GPU model/binary and 12 threads on CPUs0-11. The exact accepted final .kp contains real-space density-matrix images read by lattice-cell index; it is an initial guess and must reconverge on the new mesh. The isolated molecule is unchanged. No base case is replaced and no larger automatic sweep is authorized.
comparison: (E_crystal_5x5x5 - E_crystal_3x3x3) / 4 * 2625.4996394799 kJ/mol. With unchanged molecule this is the lattice-energy shift. Compare its magnitude with 0.5 kJ/mol. A small change bounds this mesh comparison for CO2 only, not all systems or errors. Report the actual irreducible point count and any restart warning.
